label: Extended multi-run prediction replay (fixed-bias 'a' and separate-causal-bias 'b'), NOT closed-loop evidence. v2: fixed a labeling bug where B's own frozen-native logged forecast was previously mislabeled as scheduled.

cross_run_spread_at_lead_14.note: SPREAD, ACROSS THE 9 AVAILABLE RUNS, of THIS REPLAY COMPUTATION'S OWN frozen-minus-scheduled difference at lead stage 14 -- genuine repeated-measurement variability of the replay result itself. This is explicitly NOT the main campaign's across-run tracking-RMSE standard deviation (a different question: closed-loop tracking variability across repeated hardware runs) and must not be called a measurement-noise floor -- it reflects run-to-run differences in the recorded execution history (initial state, registration, camera noise in z_meas/measured_beam_position, timing jitter) feeding an otherwise-identical replay computation.
